name: Sacrosanct Midstaff
description: Hold the stave ready with one hand on the guard track and one on the strike track, qi settling in the forearms.

name: Staffsolace
description: Step forward in a paired glide, the feet matching the two tracks of the stave, qi steadying the weight.

name: Heroic Jabbing
description: Rap down on the opponent's weapon hand with the near end of the stave in a swift pulse of qi.

name: Squall Ironcap
description: Meet a blow along a straight azure line of the stave and push it wide, qi firming the arms.

name: Rowandecree
description: Thrust along a line that bends like a river around the guard, qi adjusting at the last moment.

name: Thunderclap Staffgrip
description: Press the stave down on the opponent's weapon into the basin of the guard, qi pulsing through the grip.

name: Harmonious Staffspin
description: Parry on the guard track and strike on the strike track in a single linked movement, qi carrying the join.

name: Triumphant Staffsweep
description: Sweep the stave in a wide paired arc at low height, qi hardening the shaft.

name: Orchestral Poleturn
description: Pursue the retreating opponent along both tracks, striking head and knee in turn, qi sustaining the pace.

name: Radiance Quarterpoint
description: Hold the high guard while qi gathers, then dive both ends of the stave along paired lines into the opponent's centre.

name: Magnificent Inferno Staffend
description: Gather qi on both tracks of the stave and loose them at once in a diving double strike, the school's signature stroke.

name: Staffvow
description: Open the exchange in a formal guard with the stave held upright before the face, qi gathered in the arms.

name: Wraithlike Poleturn
description: Walk forward on a smooth river-like step, qi carrying the stave on an even line.

name: Oakcrown
description: Strike level with the surface of an imagined basin, qi hardening the shaft on contact.

name: Deluge Nodeknot
description: Shed a blow off the stave as water leaves a bank, qi softening the wrists.

name: Millstone Rapidspin
description: Rap in a steady current of short blows along the opponent's arm, qi pacing the rhythm.

name: Peal Staffshoe
description: Beat the opponent's weapon aside with a firm tap of the stave, qi shaking the grip.

name: Inviolate Oakstaff
description: Hold a guard on two courses, one covering the high line and one the low, qi shared between the arms.

name: Staffcrown
description: Strike down with a heavy rising-water blow, qi gathering through the shoulders on the way.

name: Symphonic Rollover
description: Strike in rising waves, each blow stronger than the last, qi swelling through the arms.

name: Thrall Ironcap
description: Hold the opponent's weapon pinned under the stave as in a basin, qi locking the grip.

name: Illustrious Staffspin
description: Gather qi in the stave as water gathers in a basin and pour it out in two heavy strokes along separate courses.

name: Sovereign Staffsweep
description: Hold the court guard until qi has gathered fully, then break the opponent's guard in a school-taught double blow.

name: Steelash
description: Take the doctrine's guard with the stave diagonal, qi gathered in a thin field about the shaft.

name: Oakboon
description: Slide forward with the long reach of the doctrine, qi lengthening the stride.

name: Ashverdict
description: Strike along the first track, a quick flick of the stave tip, with a pulse of qi at contact.

name: Gallant Rapidspin
description: Strike along the second track, a heavier stroke following the first, qi building at the shoulders.

name: Venerable Staffend
description: Deflect a blow with both hands working in opposite tracks, turning the force aside.

name: Bedrock Poleturn
description: Rap the opponent's guard at the edge of reach and keep them there, qi pulsing.

name: Vacuum Jabbing
description: Fold the two tracks into one thrust that bores past the guard, qi narrowing at the tip.

name: Commanding Nodeknot
description: Close the stave over the opponent's weapon and hold it, qi steady in the grip.

name: Choral Staffsweep
description: Chain both tracks through a series of blows without pause, qi carrying the rhythm.

name: Famed Rollover
description: Gather qi along both tracks and break it on a single downward crushing blow.

name: Matchless Quenched Jabbing
description: Hold the stave steady while qi gathers along its length, then drive it forward as a single piercing line the guard cannot turn.

name: Ashseal
description: Hold the stave high in the court's watch guard, qi spread in a field, tip trained on the opponent.

name: Spectral Staffshoe
description: Glide forward in the long step of the court, qi carrying the body low and fast.

name: Perchbanner
description: Stoop from the high guard onto the opponent's guard hand, qi flaring at the tip.

name: Parity Staffgrip
description: Spread the arms along the stave to parry wide and open the opponent's guard, qi firming the shaft.

name: Ashtroth
description: Beat the opponent's weapon across the body with a crossing rap of the stave, qi shaking the grip.

name: Prism Rapidspin
description: Thrust along a straight blue-sky line, qi narrowing to a point.

name: Quenched Rollover
description: Rap down once on each side of the opponent's guard in quick order, qi driving each.

name: Fettering Staffend
description: Hook the stave around the opponent's weapon like a talon and hold it, qi locking the grip.

name: Staffbanner
description: Chase a retreating opponent with a diving chain of strikes, qi sustaining the pace.

name: Dauntless Staffsweep
description: Hold high while qi gathers, then stoop in two dives along paired lines at once.

name: Imperial Jabbing
description: Loose the gathered qi in a signature paired descent, one stroke at the guard and one under it, the court's master blow.

name: Sphere Midstaff
description: Hold the stave in a guard that draws qi into two basins in the body, one for each arm.

name: Perchgrace
description: Step with qi alternating between the two basins, carrying the stave evenly through the pattern.

name: Royal Poleturn
description: Rap with the stave using the first basin, a quick bright pulse at the tip.

name: Vigorstaff
description: Follow with the second basin's pulse, heavier and slower than the first.

name: Pall Oakstaff
description: Deflect a blow with qi from one basin while the other basin stays full.

name: Entropy Nodeknot
description: Press the stave and its field against the opponent's weapon from two basins' worth of qi.

name: Pulsar Staffsweep
description: Link both basins in a single piercing thrust, qi doubled at the tip.

name: Binding Ironcap
description: Hold the opponent's weapon bound in the field of one basin while the other remains ready.

name: Tenet Staffspin
description: Strike and release alternately from the two basins in a steady chain, the school's hallmark rhythm.

name: Fearless Rollover
description: Fill both basins with qi and spill them together onto the opponent's guard in one breaking stroke.

name: Majestic Thunderclap Poleturn
description: Let both basins' qi meet at the stave's tip in a signature blow whose force exceeds either alone.

name: Oakpledge
description: Seat the stance on the formed Core and hold the stave in guard, Core qi settling in the arms.

name: Silken Midstaff
description: Step with qi drawn from the Core, the stave held level and the body carried along the river line.

name: Exalted Jabbing
description: Rap with a pulse of Core qi at the tip, bright and sharp.

name: Kernel Ironcap
description: Parry with Core qi stiffening the stave, turning aside a heavy blow.

name: Squallash
description: Strike along the flowing river line with the Core pouring qi down the arms.

name: Venom Nodeknot
description: Press the stave on the opponent's weapon, Core qi tightening the grip.

name: Nucleus Rapidspin
description: Thrust with Core qi narrowed to a thread at the tip, driving through the guard.

name: Despotic Staffgrip
description: Hold the opponent's weapon in a basin of Core qi around the stave.

name: Volition Rollover
description: Chain strikes along the two tracks with Core qi flowing between them.

name: Vaunted Poleturn
description: Gather Core qi and break it on a single heavy downward smash.

name: Splendid Staffsweep
description: Hold the stance while the Core pours qi into the stave, then release it along two tracks in one stroke.

name: Magnificent Staffspin
description: Join the two tracks at the Core and loose the whole of the court's qi in a signature blow of the manual.

name: Prismoak
description: Take a bearing on the opponent and set the stave along it, qi steadying the legs against the wind.

name: Soundless Rollover
description: Walk into the wind with a level stave, qi lightening the body.

name: Intrepid Staffend
description: Rap along the bearing at the opponent's weapon hand, qi flicking down the shaft.

name: Peal Midstaff
description: Turn a blow aside from a crosswind angle, qi firming the arms.

name: Perchdecree
description: Thrust along the bearing as an oath is kept, straight and unturning, qi narrowing at the tip.

name: Imperious Staffshoe
description: Beat the opponent's weapon from its line with a gusting tap, qi shaking the grip.

name: Ashdecree
description: Parry and strike along one held bearing in a single motion, qi carrying the join.

name: Heroic Staffspin
description: Sweep the stave in a long wind-like arc, qi hardening the wood.

name: Orchestral Rapidspin
description: Press the opponent back with a string of strikes on the same line, qi sustaining the pace.

name: Paramount Quarterpoint
description: Hold the bearing steady while qi gathers in the stave, then bring it down in a blow along that line.

name: Valiant Inferno Poleturn
description: Fix the bearing and release the gathered qi along it in the school's signature strike, which the sworn student does not turn from.

name: Perchtroth
description: Hold the stave upright before the body in a still guard, the breath slow and qi pooled in the legs.

name: Ashodyssey
description: Step on the plateau in a long steady stride, qi carrying the weight evenly.

name: Oakbanner
description: Rap the opponent's lead hand in a quick even pulse, qi flicking along the shaft.

name: Revered Staffgrip
description: Turn a blow aside as the wind turns a banner, qi softening and stiffening the wrists.

name: Staffpledge
description: Beat the opponent's weapon away with a firm tap of the stave, qi pulsing through the grip.

name: Steel Jabbing
description: Thrust along the bearing with a steady narrowing thread of qi.

name: Staffverdict
description: Sweep low across the plateau ground at the opponent's legs, qi hardening the stave.

name: Millstone Staffshoe
description: Hold the stave on the opponent's weapon like an oath kept in the wind, qi locking the grip.

name: Resonant Rollover
description: Strike in the measured beat of a sworn chant, each blow in time and each with its pulse of qi.

name: Choral Poleturn
description: Chain strikes, each one pledging the next, qi carrying the blows unbroken.

name: Lordly Staffend
description: Hold the guard and gather qi to the sound of the breath, then drive it down in one heavy stroke.

name: Peerless Rollover
description: Release the gathered qi along the bearing in the masters' signature blow, the blow of a sworn word spoken once.

name: Undefiled Quarterpoint
description: Face the wind with the stave braced, qi sinking into the legs as the sea wind rises.

name: Skyborne Staffgrip
description: Step into the gale with a low sure footing, qi keeping the stave level.

name: Squall Jabbing
description: Rap in a quick gusting stroke at the weapon hand, qi flashing at the tip.

name: Deluge Oakstaff
description: Turn a blow outward as an offshore wind turns a sail, qi stiffening the shaft.

name: Staffedict
description: Thrust straight ahead like a headland into the sea, qi driving the tip.

name: Tyrannous Staffshoe
description: Beat the opponent's weapon in the rhythm of the tide, qi shaking the grip loose.

name: Oakedict
description: Sweep the stave in a broad arc along a held bearing, qi hardening the shaft.

name: Sigil Nodeknot
description: Hold the opponent's weapon against the stave like a rock against a wave, qi locking the grip.

name: Grand Rollover
description: Chain strikes in a rising gale, each carried by the one before, qi growing with the rhythm.

name: Triumphant Poleturn
description: Gather qi in the stave as a wave gathers, then bring it down in a breaking stroke.

name: Peerless Steel Staffsweep
description: Hold the bearing while qi gathers, then loose it in the doctrine's signature sweep that clears a guard like a storm tide.

name: Rowanvow
description: Rest in the wind-sworn guard, stave across the body, qi settling in the arms.

name: Feather Staffend
description: Slide along the bearing with the stave levelled, qi keeping balance on the plateau.

name: Ashcrown
description: Tap the opponent's hand with a gusting stroke, qi flicking down the wood.

name: Faithful Staffgrip
description: Parry in a gust of the stave and return in the same line, qi stiffening the shaft.

name: Pulsaroak
description: Thrust straight along the sworn bearing, qi gathered to a point.

name: Peremptory Nodeknot
description: Beat the opponent's weapon from its line on open ground, qi shaking the grip.

name: Quenched Staffspin
description: Sweep the stave across the line of a crosswind at the opponent's legs, qi hardening the stave.

name: Thrall Staffgrip
description: Close the stave on the opponent's weapon and hold it still, qi making the hold like a sworn vow.

name: Symphonic Staffend
description: Run across the plateau in a chain of strikes, the stave never idle, qi keeping pace.

name: Matchless Staffsweep
description: Gather qi on a held bearing and bring the stave down in a blow that carries the whole of the body.

name: Dauntless Rollover
description: Hold the bearing as long as qi takes to gather, then loose the wind-sworn signature stroke straight along it.

name: Consecrated Ironcap
description: Face all four winds in turn with the stave across the body, qi spreading in a field about the arms.

name: Rowanvoyage
description: Pivot through the bearings with a gliding step, qi turning the legs and the stave together.

name: Oakverdict
description: Rap from the east, a quick light wind of a stroke, qi flicking at the tip.

name: Haemalash
description: Rap from the west, answering the east with a heavier pulse of qi.

name: Parity Midstaff
description: Parry in the crossing of two winds, turning the blow aside between them.

name: Radiance Rapidspin
description: Thrust with the cold narrow force of the north, qi thinning to a thread.

name: Famed Staffspin
description: Sweep with the warm broad force of the south, qi flowing through the shaft.

name: Thrallash
description: Hold the opponent's weapon still in the stillness between winds, qi locking the grip.

name: Destiny Poleturn
description: Strike from all four bearings in turn, each blow changing the field around the stave.

name: Royal Jabbing
description: Gather qi from the four bearings into the stave and release it as a gale from all sides at once.

name: Exalted Squall Quarterpoint
description: Let all four winds of the forms meet at the stave's tip in the signature stroke of the manual.

name: Kernelstaff
description: Root the stance on the formed Core and hold the stave level, Core qi pooling in the arms.

name: Twilit Poleturn
description: Step into the wind with Core qi carrying the body smoothly along the bearing.

name: Nucleus Rollover
description: Rap with a gust of Core qi at the tip, quick and sharp.

name: Unwavering Oakstaff
description: Parry with Core qi stiffening the stave, turning aside a heavy blow.

name: Kernel Jabbing
description: Thrust along the bearing with Core qi narrowed to a thread at the tip.

name: Masterful Nodeknot
description: Beat the opponent's weapon from its line, Core qi shaking the grip.

name: Rowantriumph
description: Sweep the stave in a long arc with Core qi extending the reach.

name: Authoritative Ironcap
description: Hold the opponent's weapon in a field of Core qi about the stave.

name: Rowancrown
description: Chain strikes along a held bearing, Core qi flowing between each.

name: Imperial Staffsweep
description: Gather Core qi into the stave and bring it down in one breaking blow.

name: Sovereign Poleturn
description: Hold the bearing while the Core fills the stave with qi, then release it in the school's sworn signature stroke.
